correctness.rationale: For each finite sample window, grouping starting indices into the m cyclic phases gives exactly one active binary residue per phase or a fully marker-valued signature. Disjoint binary and marker alphabets make active phases mutually disjoint and disjoint from silent phases. Uniform recurrence preserves every finite sampled language after the possible one-step carry, yielding the exact decomposition p_y(T)=sum_r p_x(U_r)+D_w(S). Attainment of p_x^*(n)=2n for each independently chosen U_r proves the all-k optimization. In the one-defect template, the number of B-signatures is the number of occupied-to-empty cyclic transitions and an all-A signature is present iff the complement has an adjacent pair, yielding the sharp formula and explicit maximizing supports. All m≥2 and k≥1, and m≥3 for one-defect, are covered. The embedded finite checker passes 17861 independent assertions, but the argument above, not those computations, establishes the universal assertions.

originality.rationale: The closest full primary paper (Schlortt arXiv:2505.05627v1) establishes eventual 2k+C and provides particular examples, while Le–Pavlov–Schlortt arXiv:2508.13420v1 describes related interleavings structurally. Neither inspected full text identifies all finite-length constants by cyclic phase signatures or proves the arbitrary-period one-exception four-letter correction min(k+1,ceil(m/2)). The baseline binary 2k and already published small examples are explicitly excluded from novelty. Relevant published mathematical searches and indexed result searches found no dominating statement; this is positive but not conclusive evidence, and specialized priority risks are identified.
residual_risks: Unlocated earlier specialized formula for maximal-pattern complexity of fixed-color periodic templates might be equivalent under a different alphabet or cyclic-index convention.
The Toeplitz 2006 full manuscript and the 2006 Kamae–Rao paper were not fully read; their indexed abstracts do not resolve priority for specialized cases.
A close upper-bound phase-partition argument already appears in the motivating source; the quantitative generalization should not be represented as wholly independent of that mechanism.
Exact-rational finite checks are supplementary and cannot establish novelty or infinite-word properties.

value.rationale: The paper motivating this problem leaves the eventual additive constant C unspecified for general constant-residue interleavings; exact all-length complexity is a natural missing invariant. The finite cyclic signature formula resolves C and onset for every marker template. The one-defect family proves that fixed four-letter symbolic systems can have arbitrarily large eventual additive excess and computes the sharp saturation length, a structural phenomenon not implied by alphabet-based minimality or numerical correctness. This is a motivated natural complete classification for an infinite family, not an isolated arbitrary finite sample or routine renaming.
